intentional_diffs: 1. repo identity: `_require_trusted_repo` (exact match against repo_identity via the fixed on-disk path) runs in the public `run_transaction` / `reconcile_transaction` (and therefore `main`, and `run_transaction_with_authoritative_readback`) BEFORE any `gh` call. Source only checked that --repo was `<owner>/<name>`. A wrong, legacy, malformed or missing repo and an unusable identity config/module are `repo-identity` failures with zero gh calls.

2. approved operations: label / native parent (sub-issue) / blocked-by / blocking are unapproved live operations. `_gate_approved_operations` rejects (`unapproved-operation`, zero gh calls) any effective label (explicit `--label`, `--issue-kind implementation` auto labels, and `--label-profile triage_only`, which ALWAYS adds `triage-required`), `--parent-issue`, `--blocked-by`/`--dependency`, `--blocking`, in both create and reconcile. A body-derived parent is rejected right after local body parsing and before the first gh call (`approved_operations_only`). Source applied all of them after the create.

3. structure: the source bodies are kept as `_run_transaction_engine` / `_reconcile_transaction_engine` (label/parent/dependency handlers retained, not reachable from any CLI/library entrypoint; AST test pins the only two callers). The public names are the gated wrappers with the same signature.

4. create failure classification: the `gh issue create` step is wrapped. Source let the TransactionError escape (a traceback from `main`, no JSON receipt). Now timeout / empty or unparsable URL / a non-zero exit with a visible issue become `issue-create-outcome-unknown` after an authoritative title readback (candidate number reported); only a definite non-zero exit with a clean readback stays `issue-create`, and neither asserts no-mutation.
5. `main` converts an escaped TransactionError into a JSON failure receipt (exit 1) instead of a traceback; dispatch moved to `_dispatch`.

6. SKILL.md / issue-creator.md: approval-boundary sections added (the source text describes label/parent/dependency usage and raw gh recovery; that is documentation, not approval). `--issue-kind` absent + MRC kind in the body is the label-free route.
7. tests: engine substitution in the two source txn test files; conftest reduced to an import shim; live canary test deferred.
